question: What salvific outcome for family and self follows from the prescribed observance?
premises: The practitioner uplifts twenty-one generations of the family.
The practitioner goes to the world of Viṣṇu.
These outcomes are stated as results of the act.
inference: The observance leads to ancestral upliftment and attainment of Viṣṇu's world.
plain_english: Having uplifted twenty-one generations of his family, he goes to the world of Viṣṇu.
